lockKey.description: The logical key on which to lock. This key is relative only to the node on which the lock is being acquired.

lockWaitTimeoutSeconds.description: The maximum amount of time to wait to acquire the lock

executePredicate.description:
If provided, then this will be executed before attempting to acquire the lock and again before executing the
function to determine whether it is still necessary to acquire the lock and execute the function.

For example, if the function is trying to download a file to a given path, then this predicate could check
whether the file already exists.

func.description: The function that will be executed once the lock is acquired.

title: Spec for {@link GenaiCore.Util#executeWithLock} to execute a function with a lock.
name: GenaiCore.Util.ExecuteWithLockSpec
